wins: units die and come back, so every cell I lose is refilled and its Place acts again
front: Death: an egg stays in the cell and at my round end turns back into the unit, so the dot I lost is mine again when the base is counted (NEW RULE: an egg turns into a card's unit)
backrow: A unit that comes back fires its Place again, hitting the enemy facing it and the cell behind it
lanes: A returning unit may appear in a free cell of another lane that I choose (NEW RULE: a returning unit changes lane)
holds: When my front unit dies or leaves, the unit behind it steps into the cell and gains +1 strength (NEW RULE: a free move made by an effect)
place: Place: bring back a unit of mine that died this round into a free cell of any lane for no supply, and its Place acts again
blind: damage from a spell in my hand, with no unit needed

wins: units die on purpose, and every loss makes the units behind stronger and pays for bigger ones
front: The unit that steps into the empty front cell has grown from the loss and kills the enemy that took the cell
backrow: It does not reach them directly: each stronger unit that steps up kills the one in front of it, cell by cell, until the back rows are reached
lanes: Place: destroy a unit of mine in another lane to pay for this unit here (NEW RULE: a cost paid with a unit of another lane)
holds: Every front unit has Death: this lane gets supply equal to its supply this round, so I refill the cell at once
place: Place: destroy a unit of mine in this lane and gain its supply in this lane for this round
blind: taking an enemy's text away for good

wins: one card hits a whole row, so I lose one unit and he loses many
front: Round end: this unit dies and every enemy around it takes fixed damage, including the facing front cells, and the base is counted right after
backrow: Place or spell: fixed damage to every enemy in the back row of this lane
lanes: One higher-cost area card hits the same row in all three lanes (NEW RULE: damage crosses lanes)
holds: Place: choose an enemy cell; at my next round end every enemy in it takes 3 fixed damage, so he must move out or lose the unit (NEW RULE: a hit that waits for round end)
place: Place or spell: fixed damage to every enemy in one row of the enemy camp in this lane, I choose front, middle or back
blind: giving defence back to wounded units

wins: every spell I cast makes my units and lanes stronger, so a turn of many spells wins the base
front: Each spell I cast gives my units in one row of my camp +1 strength until round end, so my front unit beats the one holding the base (NEW RULE: a unit reacts to my spell)
backrow: The card made by an empty enemy front is a free unit with Ranged reach and +1 strength for each spell this round, so it hits his back row the turn it is placed
lanes: Each spell I cast in one lane gives my units in the same row of the other two lanes +1 strength until round end
holds: Round end: for each lane where no enemy faces my units I get a new card that was not in my deck, so a held lane feeds me
place: Place: a new 0-supply Ranged unit that was not in my deck goes into my hand
blind: moving enemy units out of their cells

wins: spells from my hand remove his units while his next cards cost more, so he cannot refill
front: Spell: fixed damage to the enemy in one front cell I choose, without using my strike, so his dot is gone and mine stands
backrow: A damage spell chooses any one enemy in the lane, even in the back row
lanes: A damage spell aims at an enemy in another lane and is paid from carry-over (NEW RULE: a spell aims at another lane)
holds: Every spell I cast makes his next card cost 1 more this round, so he cannot refill the cell I cleared (NEW RULE: my spell raises the enemy's costs)
place: Place: the enemy's next unit and spell cost +1 supply until round end in this lane (NEW RULE: my effect raises the enemy's costs)
blind: extra small units put on the grid

wins: units stand close and heal, so my front is too thick to break
front: If I hold all three front cells of a lane, every front unit there gains +1 strength and wins the strike against the unit facing it
backrow: It mainly does not: its backed-up units win every front trade, and the back rows fall only when the front is gone
lanes: Round end: restore a wounded friend in any lane, so a lane that was beaten down is fixed from the lane that was not
holds: Each unit gains +1 defence for every friend directly behind it in its column (up to 2)
place: Place: at every round end, every friend around this unit gets 2 defence back
blind: taking an enemy unit for myself

wins: every wound makes my units stronger, so he must kill each one in a single hit
front: A unit that is hit and lives deals fixed damage equal to its strength to the enemy facing it, so hitting my dot holder costs him his own dot
backrow: It mainly does not: a unit that survives a hit gives +3 strength to the unit behind it, so the back strikers grow while the front holds
lanes: Survives a hit: a friend in any lane gains +2 strength for good, so strength made in a lane under attack goes to the lane that attacks
holds: A unit that is hit and lives gains +2 strength for good
place: Place: every friend around this unit takes 1 fixed damage, and each one that lives gains +2 strength
blind: drawing extra cards

wins: my dead units go back into my deck, so the same bodies refill the same cells round after round
front: Round end: one unit from my discard pile goes on top of my deck, so first thing next round I place a unit whose Place hit clears the facing cell
backrow: The top-of-deck unit's Place hit clears one front cell first, then the back rows step up and are hit the next round
lanes: The unit on top of my deck costs 1 less when I place it in a lane other than the one it died in
holds: Death: this unit's card goes back into my deck, so the unit that died holding a dot comes round again
place: Place: draw a card; if a friend is beside this unit, draw two
blind: destroying an enemy outright, whatever its defence

wins: one huge unit kills, and the rest of its hit wrecks the units behind
front: Round end: while I have a unit of strength 5 or more in the lane, 2 fixed damage to the enemy facing each of my front units
backrow: A strike that kills with strength to spare sends the rest of the hit into the unit behind the dead one, down the column (NEW RULE: the rest of a hit passes on)
lanes: A unit of strength 5 or more in any lane turns on my big-unit cards in all three lanes
holds: A big unit costs 1 less for each friend of strength 5 or more in its lane, so a second big unit reaches the front the same round
place: Place: this unit costs 1 less for each friend of strength 5 or more in its lane
blind: units that cannot be targeted or hit

wins: I copy my best unit and pick the card I need, so one strong card is everywhere
front: Place: a copy of this unit appears in the same cell of the lane beside with the same Place hit, so one deploy strikes two blockers (NEW RULE: an effect places a unit in another lane)
backrow: It mainly does not: each copy fires the same Place hit, so deploys hit the facing cells twice and wear the enemy stack down from the front
lanes: Place: take from my deck the unit that costs exactly the leftover supply of another lane
holds: Place: shuffle 2 copies of this unit into my deck, so the unit that held a cell comes back in my draws
place: Place: look through my deck and take into my hand the unit I name
blind: a unit that attacks the turn it is placed

wins: one cheap unit is placed again and again, and each placing kills an enemy
front: A strike by this unit destroys the unit struck whatever its defence, so a 1-strength unit holds its dot and kills the big unit that cancels it
backrow: The same Place destroys one enemy in this unit's own row, so a unit placed in my back row kills an enemy in his back row
lanes: A card returned to my hand has no lane, so I place it in any lane next time, paid with carry-over from cheap replays
holds: Round end: take this unit back to my hand and place it in another lane next round; the dot it held was already counted (NEW RULE: the return happens after the base is counted)
place: Place: destroy one enemy in the same row as this unit whose supply is at most this unit's
blind: hitting every enemy in a row or area

wins: big guards take every hit while silence takes away the enemy's tricks
front: Place: take away the text of the enemy in the facing front cell for good, so it still cancels my dot but the next strike clears the cell
backrow: It does not remove them: silence takes the reach from enemy Ranged units, and my guards take every strike that could reach my back rows
lanes: A guard in a front cell also guards the same cell in the lane beside, so one wall shelters two lanes (NEW RULE: guard reaches another lane)
holds: Guard: while this unit stands in a front cell, enemy strikes in reach must hit it, so my other front cells keep their dots (NEW RULE: guard)
place: Place: this guard steps into a front cell and enemy strikes in reach must hit it
blind: bringing my dead units back

wins: I turn his units into harmless bodies or take them, so his camp works for me
front: Place: take control of the enemy in the facing front cell; it stays in its cell as mine, a two-dot swing (NEW RULE: a stolen unit stays in the enemy front cell)
backrow: Place: put this unit in an empty back-row cell of the enemy camp, from where it strikes his back row directly (NEW RULE: a unit is placed in the enemy camp)
lanes: A unit I take from the enemy goes into my camp in the lane I choose (NEW RULE: a stolen unit moves to my camp)
holds: Round end: turn every enemy in one row of this lane into a 0-strength unit, so I move first next round
place: Place: turn the enemy in the facing front cell into a 1-cell unit with 0 strength and 1 supply
blind: a unit worth more dead than alive

wins: my dots cannot be removed: shielded, hidden units make him spend two actions for each cell
front: My dot holder cannot be targeted until it attacks, so he can only cancel its dot by standing opposite, and my hidden unit strikes him first
backrow: It does not remove them: its hidden units cannot be targeted, so his reach is wasted on my shielded front until he pushes into my dots
lanes: Place: give a shield to my unit in the same cell of every lane, so one deploy shields the same cell in all three bases
holds: Round end: give a shield to every unit of mine in the front row, so every dot survives the first hit of next round
place: Place: this unit cannot be the target of enemy spells or abilities, so kill, silence, change and steal fail on it
blind: small fixed hits, often or many times

wins: my small units die and each death hurts him or fills a cell, so killing them costs him
front: Death: the unit that struck this unit takes fixed damage equal to its strength, wherever it stands
backrow: Death: fixed damage to the nearest enemy in this unit's column, however deep, so his back row is hit when my front unit dies
lanes: Death: fixed damage to the nearest enemy in the same column of the lane beside (NEW RULE: damage crosses lanes)
holds: Nine cheap small bodies fill the camp, every hit kills only one, and the front is never empty
place: Place: put small 1-cell units on two free cells next to this unit for no supply
blind: shields that cancel the next hit

wins: one unit works in two lanes and attacks twice
front: Ready on kill: when my unit kills an enemy it may attack again this round, paying its supply again (NEW RULE: a second attack in a round)
backrow: Place: ready all my Ranged units so they may attack again, so a group of them hits the back rows twice in one round (NEW RULE: a second attack in a round)
lanes: A unit's reach crosses to the same cell of the lane beside, so its strike works in two lanes (NEW RULE: reach crosses lanes)
holds: A unit that did not move this round may attack twice, so a unit holding its front cell does two units' work (NEW RULE: a second attack in a round)
place: Place: this unit's dot also cancels the enemy dot in the same column of the lane beside (NEW RULE: a unit's dot works in the lane beside)
blind: copying my own cards

wins: I push his units out of the way, so my small units hold dots without a fight
front: Place: the enemy in the facing front cell moves back one row or aside, so his cancelling unit leaves and my dot counts (NEW RULE: moving enemy units)
backrow: Pull a back-row enemy into the front row and hit it with my front units (NEW RULE: moving enemy units)
lanes: Place: pull the enemy in the front cell of the lane beside into the front cell of this lane (NEW RULE: moving enemy units across lanes)
holds: When I push an enemy into a cell held by another enemy, both take small hits, so a packed camp cannot rebuild its front (NEW RULE: moving enemy units)
place: Place: an enemy from the middle or back row is moved to a free front cell where my units reach it
blind: my cards growing while they wait in hand

wins: cards kept in my hand grow, so late big units arrive while my losses feed them
front: When my unit kills an enemy it gains +1 strength for good, so the dot holder that clears the facing cell grows harder to remove
backrow: Big grown units in my middle row have Pike reach and hit over the front row, picking off the enemy by strength
lanes: The growth of a card in my hand counts the deaths of my units in all three lanes, and I place the card in the lane that needs it
holds: Each round start a card kept in my hand gains +1 strength and +1 defence (NEW RULE: a card in the hand grows)
place: Place: this unit enters as big as the rounds it waited in my hand (NEW RULE: a card in the hand grows)
blind: turning an enemy into another unit

wins: I fill my camp with cheap bodies, and every number comes from how full the camp is
front: A unit gets +1 strength and +1 defence for each filled cell of my camp, so my front unit of a full camp beats the unit facing it
backrow: Round end: when my camp in a lane is full, the enemy unit with the most supply in that lane takes 4 fixed damage, wherever it stands
lanes: A unit counts my units in all three lanes, so one lane stacked with small units makes the other lanes strong (NEW RULE: a count reads all three lanes)
holds: A full camp holds all three dots strongly, and cheap units refill it each round from the big carry-over
place: Place: +1 carry-over, so big units deploy in round 1 (NEW RULE: carry-over start and maximum change)
blind: taking my unit back to hand to place it again

wins: units strike the moment they are placed, so I clear the blocker and take the dot in one action
front: Place: this unit strikes any enemy in the lane, even out of reach, so the blocker dies by my unit's strength and no attack is spent (NEW RULE: choose a target outside reach)
backrow: The same Place strike chooses an enemy in his back row, so a unit placed in my front row hits his back row
lanes: A unit that kills with its Place strike may move to the same cell of the next lane at once (NEW RULE: a free move to another lane)
holds: Place: this unit also attacks once now, so a unit placed at round end has already struck before he can answer (NEW RULE: a unit attacks the turn it is placed)
place: Place: two chosen enemies strike each other, strength against defence, so one action removes two units (NEW RULE: an enemy is made to strike)
blind: a unit that makes enemy attacks go where I choose
